initialAssessment.reason: An initial derivation mistakenly treated AD as horizontal and concluded AB>2 while AD=1/2.

correction.reason: D is horizontally aligned with B, not A. With B=(t,3^-t), the curve gives D=(t/2,3^-t), A=((t-1)/2,3^(1-t)); equality AB=AD yields (t+1)^2=1 and t=-2 under y_B>1. Coordinates A=(-3/2,27), B=(-2,9), D=(-1,9) give area 9.
